pillars.name: Social
pillars.story: Development achievements, settlement, migration, youth inclusion and health

cards.name: Human Development Index
cards.subtitle: Very high human development, reflecting health, education and income achievements.

cards.name: Population around St John’s
cards.subtitle: Just over 60% of the national population lived in St John parish, including the city and rural area.
cards.source: Statistics Division, Census demographic profile, pp. 3–4

cards.name: Foreign-born Population
cards.subtitle: Migration shapes the workforce and society. Share of residents with recorded country of birth.
cards.source: Statistics Division, Census demographic profile, p. 9

cards.name: Youth outside Employment, Education or Training
cards.subtitle: Youth inclusion remains important even when overall employment conditions are stronger.

cards.name: Prevalence of Overweight and Obesity
cards.subtitle: Excess weight highlights the importance of prevention and long-term health care; this is not obesity alone.

pillars.name: Economic
pillars.story: Goods dependence, public financing, tourism earnings, industry and household costs

cards.name: Total Public Debt
cards.subtitle: IMF-estimated public debt burden affects financing for services and resilience; differs from earlier government projections.

cards.name: Merchandise Imports and Exports
cards.subtitle: Imports far exceed goods exports. Exports include re-exports; services are excluded.
cards.source: National Bureau of Statistics, updated 8 June 2026

cards.name: Gross Tourism Receipts
cards.subtitle: Tourism generates substantial external earnings. This ratio is not tourism’s contribution to GDP.

cards.name: Hospitality and Construction
cards.subtitle: These sectors support economic activity. Accommodation and food services are not the whole tourism economy.
cards.source: National statistics office and ECCB, rebased national accounts

cards.name: Consumer Price Inflation
cards.subtitle: Rising prices affect purchasing power. This is a twelve-month change, not annual-average inflation.
cards.source: National Bureau of Statistics, August 2026 CPI bulletin

pillars.name: Environmental
pillars.story: Water and energy security, Barbuda’s disaster exposure and Redonda conservation

cards.name: Water Security during Drought
cards.subtitle: Desalinated water consumption exceeded 90%, compared with the report’s normal 60%. Not a current supply estimate.
cards.source: Department of Environment, State of the Environment 2021

cards.name: Electricity Generation Mix
cards.subtitle: Non-renewable generation dominates electricity supply, linking energy transition with resilience.

cards.name: Barbuda Homes Damaged by Hurricane Irma
cards.subtitle: Damage across Barbuda shows why resilient housing and disaster preparedness matter.
cards.scope: Barbuda only; historical damage, not current housing condition.

cards.name: Redonda Marine Protection
cards.subtitle: Marine area of the Redonda Ecosystem Reserve, alongside protection of the island. Designation does not measure ecosystem condition.
cards.source: Government of Antigua and Barbuda, Statutory Instrument 2023 No. 37

notes: 14 indicator themes: 5 Social, 5 Economic, 4 Environmental. Charts combine related values within a theme.
National sources underpin settlement, migration, merchandise trade, industry shares, inflation, drought and protected-area designation.
Debt and tourism receipts are IMF 2025 estimates, not the government budget’s earlier projections.
Historical census and drought values are not current conditions.
Tourism receipts are not tourism GDP contribution; hospitality sector shares are not total tourism shares.
